title: MSFS Marketplace Update: 3 NEW featured airports you need to see!
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace just loaded up a phenomenal collection of diverse destinations this week! Whether you want to land at a rugged grass strip, tackle challenging crosswind approaches in the UK Midlands, or explore beautifully updated regional gateways across the United States, there is an adventure waiting for your virtual hangar.

In this comprehensive marketplace breakdown, we split today's major releases into two logical groups to see which environments genuinely deserve a spot on your virtual flight logs:

✈️ NORTH AMERICAN REGIONAL GATEWAYS: We kick things off in Riley County, Kansas, checking out Manhattan Regional Airport (KMHK) by MSFSScenery Builders. As the second busiest commercial airport in Kansas, this scenery upgrade delivers highly detailed ground services, passenger drop-off zones, and custom static models that drastically beat the default game engine. Next, we travel to California to visit Modesto Airport (KMOD) by Spinoza. Rich in military history and surrounded by the farmlands of the San Joaquin Valley, this package features incredibly realistic flight school buildings, emergency services, and even the unique ability to spawn directly inside beautifully modeled hangars!

🌏 THE UK GENERAL AVIATION SCENE: Next, we head across the Atlantic to look at Netherthorpe Airfield (EGNF) by Burning Blue Design. Located near Worksop along the Nottinghamshire border, this historic site holds the title of the oldest continuously operating general aviation airfield in northern England—and home to the shortest licensed runway in the UK! Perfect for local VFR flying near Sheffield and Doncaster, this ultra-detailed package features over 100 custom 3D objects, fully animated hangar doors, static aircraft, custom windsocks, and an open sky bar restaurant interior.

Which of these environments are you adding to your flight routes first? Are you planning to practice tight grass landings in England, or will you be loading up a regional twin prop for a hop across Kansas or California? Let me know in the comments below!

If this structured marketplace breakdown helped you plan your next route, make sure to hit that like button and subscribe for weekly MSFS realism and scenery updates!
